understanding: WISHBONE agent scoreboard inside wishbone_slave_interface agent tracks monitor-reported completed transactions to detect lost duplicated or misordered transfers with read-data comparison only where documented reference exists; eventually-answered uses testbench timeout not documented DUT bound provenance INFERRED quick-test only.
preconditions: wishbone_slave_interface monitor reconstructs completed transactions on wb_ack_o observed on clock edges and emits to analysis port with in-flight flushed on wb_rst_i
clock period fixed per test with reset via common clock and reset not agents
wishbone_slave_interface driver owns wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i during traffic; serial and modem inputs owned by their agents and not driven here
Write and read addresses are pin values wb_adr_i with reset polarity unresolved per questions; request_timeout_cycles and drain_cycles are TESTBENCH operational limits
Scoreboard subscribed to monitor analysis port with separate pending request queue; acknowledge latency bound is testbench limit provenance INFERRED for quick testing only
check_steps: SAMPLE completed read and write transactions from wishbone_slave_interface monitor analysis port where completion is monitor-reported wb_ack_o assertion on clock edges
FOR each sampled completion APPEND to observed queue retaining wb_adr_i wb_we_i wb_sel_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o ordering

COMPARE observed queue against pending request queue in order: IF head request matches address plus we plus sel plus dat_i RETIRE as answered; IF identifier already retired FLAG duplicated; IF payload order differs FLAG misordered
IF sampled completion is read AND documented reference expected data is available COMPARE wb_dat_o under explicit mask; ELSE RECORD wb_dat_o without PASS versus FAIL on value

WAIT for traffic done THEN WAIT drain_cycles THEN WAIT request_timeout_cycles as TESTBENCH operational limits; FOR any pending request with no observed completion FLAG potentially lost against testbench timeout not DUT bound
ON wb_rst_i FLUSH pending plus in-flight per monitor flush rule and RESET scoreboard counters; CLEANUP queues and counters at test end
completion: Scoreboard active from reset release through traffic until drain_cycles plus request_timeout_cycles elapse or TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit
At least one observed versus pending queue comparison attempted when traffic present
drain_cycles and request_timeout_cycles are TESTBENCH operational limits not DUT acknowledge requirements
